purpose: Dynamic active Brand master + Role Brand authorization across Role, Customer assignment, and Dashboard Brand / Series Settings.

rules.role_brand_assigned: All active Brands from Brand Management; future OEM Brands appear automatically as choices.
rules.customer_brand_assigned: All active Brands from Brand Management; preserved from V4.15.
rules.dashboard_brand_series_settings: Shows active Brands allowed by current Role authorization. Unrestricted roles see all active Brands.
rules.future_oem_brand: Appears automatically in Role/Customer lists; restricted users need Owner authorization before Dashboard/Product/Selection access.
rules.inactive_brand: Not offered for new active-brand settings; historical stored identities remain outside this UI change.
